title: GTM-CS 1:1 prep — Samira & Alex: Q2 renewal risk + enablement
content:
Purpose: quick sync before upcoming renewals + surface enablement needs and handoffs.

High level goals for this 1:1:
- Align on top 3 at-risk renewals for Q2 and concrete next actions
- Identify enablement gaps for Alex (handoff materials, playbooks, tech FAQs)
- Decide which accounts need SE deep dive vs. AE-led remediation
- Quick review of CS health signals + ask for resources (trial credits, exec intro)

Context / background notes (quick):
- Renewal season: 6 accounts >$50k coming up June–July. Internal renewal risk score updated 2026-06-09.
- Recent incidents: two perf regressions in May caused customer complaint tickets (infra/latency). We routed to ENG, applied mitigations (cache tweaks) but some customers still nervous.
- New pricing/packaging email sent May 28 — mixed reception; a few accounts requesting discounted committed capacity rather than metered.

Top at-risk accounts (ranked) — short notes / ask from Alex:
1) Nimbus Retail (ARR $210k) — "security + latency"
   - Current health: NPS-2 recent support ticket; demo last week OK but exec contact worried about perf for holiday peak.
   - Immediate ask: Alex to re-open exec thread and offer a 1-hour architecture review with SE + offer 3-day free dedicated capacity pilot.
   - My follow-up: prep SE notes and cost calc for pilot; draft pilot scope doc (deadline: 6/15).

2) GreenWave Media (ARR $95k) — "budget pressure + usage spike"
   - Current health: Usage spiked 2x in April, surprised by token costs. Finance asking for predictable pricing.
   - Ask: Alex to propose reserved capacity pricing or custom commit; loop in Pricing if needed.
   - My follow-up: prepare usage report + forecast to justify commit levels; intro to Pricing (Priya).

3) Atlas Finance (ARR $60k) — "compliance questions for Private deploy"
   - Current health: evaluating Private deployment; blocked on KMS integration + SOC2 docs.
   - Ask: Alex to request Security enablement session with our compliance SME; offer whitepaper.
   - My follow-up: gather SOC2 artifacts and KMS integration checklist; schedule session week of 6/22.

Enablement asks from Alex (what he needs from CS/SE/Product):
- Quick one-pager on Dedicated vs Hosted economics with examples (tokens vs reserved) — urgent for GreenWave conversation.
- Short runbook for perf incidents to reassure Nimbus execs (what we do, expected timelines).
- SE availability windows (2 possible slots) so Alex can schedule architecture call.

Questions I want to ask Alex in the 1:1:
- Which of these accounts does he feel confident converting with a standard commit vs needing heavy SE involvement?
- For Nimbus: does he have an existing exec relationship that would accept a 30-min rescue call? If not, we escalate to VP CS.
- GreenWave: what price band would he consider viable (range) so I can prepare pricing options?
- Any fast wins we can show within 72 hours to reduce churn risk?

Proposed agenda (15–20 min):
1) Quick check-in (2 min) — mood, bandwidth
2) Review 3 at-risk accounts and owners/asks (8–10 min)
3) Enablement requests & immediate deliverables (4–5 min)
4) Agree next steps + owners + deadlines (2 min)

Draft next steps (to convert to Jira tasks after 1:1):
- Samira: Draft pilot scope doc for Nimbus and send to Alex (due 2026-06-15) — Jira JIRA-4782 subtask.
- Alex: Reach out to Nimbus exec + schedule 60-min architecture review with SE (target 6/16).
- Samira: Pull usage + cost forecast for GreenWave and intro to Pricing/Priya (due 6/14).
- Alex: Capture target pricing band for GreenWave in quick note (due 6/13).
- Samira: Compile SOC2/KMS artifacts for Atlas and schedule compliance session with SME (due 6/22).

Notes to self (informal) — do before 1:1:
- Prep 1-page Dedicated vs Hosted economics (use last quarter examples from pricing deck).
- Create a 1-slide perf incident runbook (steps, expected SLA, escalation path).
- Check SE calendar and propose two 60-min windows on 6/16 and 6/18.
- Find exec contact details for Nimbus in Salesforce (if not present, ask Alex to share).

Open / unresolved items:
- Confirm if we can offer "3-day dedicated pilot" as a standard temporary credit (policy question for Finance).
- Determine whether we need legal sign-off for pilot MOU for Nimbus.

Tone / reminders for the convo:
- Be collaborative and solutions-first — offer pilot / architecture review as a trust-building move, not a discount.
- Emphasize reliability improvements already shipped and concrete guardrails (fallbacks, cached prefix).
- Keep next steps timeboxed and owner-assigned.

Post-1:1 follow-up template (what I'll send after the meeting):
- Quick note: Thanks + summary of decisions + owners + due dates + attachments (pilot scope, usage report, SOC2 pack).
- Ask Alex to confirm wording for executive outreach and copy execs if ready.

— Samira

Notes: rough scratchpad. Will clean and convert to Jira tasks after sync.
